item.title: Nigerian security forces on high alert for large-scale attack on airport and prison, memo says
item.summary: An internal memo obtained by the Associated Press shows that Nigeria's security forces have received intelligence on planned attacks on the capital city, Abuja, and neighboring Niger state by terrorist groups

item.title: UN nuclear chief urges strict Iran checks in any deal to end war
item.summary: The head of the U.N.’s nuclear watchdog says that “very detailed” measures to verify Iran’s nuclear activities must be put in place in a potential U.S.-Iran agreement to end their war in the Middle East

item.title: Sudan enters a fourth year of war as officials lament an 'abandoned crisis'
item.summary: Sudan is entering a fourth year of war marked by famine and massacres in what the United Nations calls an “abandoned crisis.”

item.title: Sweden blames pro-Russian group for cyberattack on energy infrastructure
item.summary: The Swedish government says a pro-Russian actor was behind a cyberattack on a heating plant in western Sweden last year

item.title: Seoul court sentences US YouTuber to 6 months in jail over offensive stunts
item.summary: An American YouTuber who sparked national outrage in South Korea for provocative stunts, including dancing on a statue honoring victims of wartime sexual slavery, was sentenced to six months in prison by a Seoul court on Wednesday

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy pursues more arms deals with allies to help check Russia's invasion
item.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine’s top priority is securing help to buy and build more air defense systems

item.title: Mediators move closer to extending US-Iran ceasefire, officials tell AP
item.summary: Mediators are moving closer to extending the ceasefire between the United States and Iran and restarting negotiations to salvage the fragile truce before it expires next week

item.title: Cameroon hopes the pope's visit brings healing after nearly a decade of conflict
item.summary: People in Cameroon hope that Pope Leo XIV's visit will bring peace to the conflict-ridden country

item.title: A look at Sudan's war by the numbers
item.summary: Sudan is entering a fourth year of war between the military and paramilitary forces

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Brazil's Lula defends Pope Leo in message to Catholics after Trump's criticism
item.summary: Brazil’s President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said on Wednesday that Pope Leo XIV should be defended from “powerful people” who have recently criticized him
